Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you
reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give the facts of what happened, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine, but I still need your name for the file. Once you've given it, please describe where you were when the
collision occurred.
A: Okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved. I was in Katy, Texas, on a fairly busy road, heading toward a shopping
center.
Q: What were you doing at the moment of impact?
A: I was turning left into the entrance of the center. There was a gap in oncoming traffic, so I started the turn.
Q: Did you have a green light or a signal to turn?
A: I had a green arrow for the left turn, I'm fairly sure of that. The oncoming lanes had a red light, so I proceeded.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front driver's side of my car. It came into the intersection faster
than I expected. I braked as hard as I could, but it was too late.
Q: Did you see that vehicle before you began the turn?
A: I saw headlights earlier, but they were far enough back that I judged I had time.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My left wrist hit the steering wheel and the airbag deployed. I was taken by ambulance to the hospital, and
they told me the wrist is fractured. I've been weraing a splint since then.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want my car and my medical bills taken care of as soon as possible. That's all I have for now.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
